question: A person on anti-tubercular drugs complained of deafness and tinnitus in one ear. Drug implicated is?
analysis: Streptomycin, an aminoglycoside antibiotic, is known to cause ototoxicity, which can manifest as hearing loss (deafness) and tinnitus. This side effect is particularly noted with its use in the treatment of tuberculosis. The other drugs listed (Isoniazid, Ethambutol, Rifampicin) are also used in tuberculosis treatment but are not commonly associated with ototoxic effects.
